# Create: Enchantment Industry template sprites

The following Forgermod assets are purple palette adaptations of the corresponding animated template sprites from Create: Enchantment Industry 2.5.4b by DragonsPlus:

- `src/main/resources/assets/forgermod/textures/item/augment_template.png` from `enchanting_template.png`
- `src/main/resources/assets/forgermod/textures/item/super_augment_template.png` from `super_enchanting_template.png`

The original project is at https://github.com/DragonsPlusMinecraft/CreateEnchantmentIndustry. These adapted sprites are distributed under LGPL-3.0-or-later; see `LICENSE.txt` in this directory. All frames preserve the original 16×16 outlines and timing. Colors were changed to purple for Forgermod.
